correctness.rationale: A fresh exact replay using the disjoint-pairs presentation of Petersen enumerates the 64 even-incidence edge subsets, selects the pentagons and hexagons by weight, and separately checks that the six weight-ten words are all disjoint-pentagon pairs. It counts all 32768 signed character sums and certifies the independently computed group-algebra identity k^4−16k^2=576·1_even-cycle-space. The signed counts are 512,7680,16384,7680,512 at −12,−4,0,4,12. The polynomial (160k^2−k^4)/2304 equals the spectral-support idempotent and has exactly the claimed coefficients. Character orthogonality yields rank and nullity 16384 and Euclidean range condition number 3. Averaging an arbitrary range projection over translations preserves range and identity on it and contracts both operator norms. The resulting convolution projection is forced by its character multipliers. Convolution attains its kernel l1 norm 5/2 at a point mass for l1 and at a sign-matched vector for l-infinity, over either field. No uploaded script was executed.
residual_risks: The character computation is exhaustive only for this Petersen edge group. Uniqueness is for translation-invariant projections, not asserted for all norm minimizers.
